title: Remove or wire dead configuration
notes: Removed unused dead configuration fields (candidate.reuse_existing, run.epoch_actions, run.restart_every_minutes, run.parallel_actions).
Wired CodexSettings (tester_model, repair_model, json_events, tester_timeout_seconds, repair_timeout_seconds) to TesterCodex, RepairerCodex, and CodexRunner.
Added RepairVerifier.run_full_suite to support whole-suite verification runs.
